m: **Forge** and **refine** your body like hot metal: **exercise** and **toughen** up.
ex: 我每天早上都去公园锻炼。
I go to the park to exercise every morning.
这份工作很锻炼人。
This job really toughens a person up.
use: Used for physical exercise (锻炼身体) and for building character or skills.

ex: 他是我们足球队的队长。
He is the captain of our football team.
队长让大家先休息一下。
The team leader told everyone to take a short break.
use: For sports teams and small groups; a company boss is not 队长.

m: Your own **body** **examines** it: you **experience it for yourself**.
ex: 我想体验一下农村生活。
I'd like to experience country life for myself.
这次旅行是一次很好的体验。
This trip was a great experience.
use: Stresses first-hand experience; 经验 is experience as know-how you have built up.

m: Put a **ridge** round the fields and **break** off everyone else's access: you **monopolize** it.
ex: 这家公司垄断了整个市场。
This company has monopolized the whole market.
政府要打破行业垄断。
The government wants to break up industry monopolies.
use: Mostly about markets and business; often 打破垄断, break a monopoly.

m: **Eight** things to **guard against**: the Buddhist **eight precepts**, and the name of the pig monk **Bajie**.
ex: 小朋友都喜欢猪八戒。
Children all love Zhu Bajie, the pig.
八戒在路上又饿了。
Bajie got hungry again on the road.
use: Usually the pig in Journey to the West, 猪八戒, known for being greedy and lazy.

m: **Weigh** it up and name **it** **as**: you **call it** this.
ex: 人们把这里称之为美食街。
People call this place Food Street.
这种现象可以称之为文化冲突。
This kind of thing can be called a culture clash.
use: Written style; 之 means it. Often 把…称之为 or 被称之为.

m: Put on your **shoes** and **walk** the path you promised: **fulfil** a duty.
ex: 每个人都应该履行自己的责任。
Everyone should fulfil their own responsibilities.
公司没有履行合同。
The company did not carry out the contract.
use: Formal; goes with 义务, 责任, 合同, 承诺.

ex: 他在工商银行工作。
He works at the Industrial and Commercial Bank.
开店以前要先去工商局登记。
Before opening a shop you must register with the business administration office.
use: Common in names: 工商银行, 工商局 (business licensing office).

ex: 我们周末去城外爬山。
We go climbing in the hills outside the city at weekends.
城外的空气比城里好多了。
The air outside the city is much better than in town.
use: Opposite of 城里, in town.

ex: 北方人种小麦比较多。
People in the north mostly grow wheat.
面包是用小麦做的。
Bread is made from wheat.
use: Measure word 粒 for grains; 面粉 is the flour made from it.

m: A **straight** **path** right across the circle: the **diameter**.
ex: 这个圆的直径是十厘米。
The diameter of this circle is ten centimetres.
这棵树的直径有一米多。
This tree is more than a metre across.
use: Maths and measuring word; radius is 半径.

ex: 他为了梦想一直在奋斗。
He has kept striving for his dream.
年轻人应该努力奋斗。
Young people should work hard and strive.
use: Often 为…奋斗, strive for something; sounds earnest and positive.

m: The **west**-**north** **part**: the **northwest part** of a place.
ex: 新疆在中国的西北部。
Xinjiang is in the northwest of China.
这个国家的西北部有很多山。
There are many mountains in the northwest of this country.
use: Pattern: place + 的 + direction + 部, like 东南部.

ex: 道教是中国本土的宗教。
Taoism is a religion native to China.
这座山上有很多道教的庙。
There are many Taoist temples on this mountain.
use: Taoism as a religion; the philosophy is often called 道家.

m: Things **made into** one by **closing** together into a new **thing**: a **chemical compound**.
ex: 水是一种化合物。
Water is a compound.
这种化合物对人体有害。
This compound is harmful to the human body.
use: Chemistry term; measure word 种.

m: A **single**, **pure** thing with nothing mixed in: **simple** and **pure**.
ex: 她是个很单纯的女孩。
She is a very innocent, simple-hearted girl.
事情没有你想的那么单纯。
Things aren't as simple as you think.
use: About people: naive or innocent; about matters: uncomplicated. 简单 is simple as in easy.

m: **Send** something **to** someone: **give it as a present**.
ex: 这本书是送给你的。
This book is a present for you.
我把那束花送给了妈妈。
I gave that bunch of flowers to my mum.
use: Pattern: 送给 + person + thing, or 把 + thing + 送给 + person.

m: A **thousand** grams, written with the sound of **克**: a **kilogram**.
ex: 这袋大米重十千克。
This bag of rice weighs ten kilograms.
我最近瘦了两千克。
I've lost two kilograms recently.
use: Formal unit; in speech people say 公斤. 斤 is half a kilo.

m: The **straight**-on **face** of a thing: the **front**, the **positive side**.
ex: 请在信封的正面写地址。
Please write the address on the front of the envelope.
我们要多看事情的正面。
We should look more at the positive side of things.
use: Opposite 反面 or 背面; also means positive (正面影响) or head-on (正面回答).

m: **Preserve** a machine and **fix it up**: **maintenance** and **repair**.
ex: 电梯正在维修，请走楼梯。
The lift is under repair, please take the stairs.
这台空调需要定期维修。
This air conditioner needs regular maintenance.
use: For machines, buildings, cars; 修理 is a plainer word for repair.

m: **Comment on** it and give **opinions**: people **talk about** it.
ex: 大家都在议论这件事。
Everyone is talking about this.
别在背后议论别人。
Don't talk about people behind their backs.
use: Often gossip or public discussion; 讨论 is a planned discussion.

ex: 我的钱包丢了，快叫警察！
My wallet's gone, call the police!
那个警察帮我找到了路。
That police officer helped me find the way.
use: Measure word 个 or 名; 警察局 is a police station.

m: Take a **great** **look** at the whole: **macro**, the big picture.
ex: 我们要从宏观上看问题。
We need to look at the problem from the big picture.
宏观经济最近不太稳定。
The macroeconomy hasn't been very stable lately.
use: Opposite 微观, micro; common in economics and policy talk.

m: A **name** carrying the **right** to act: in someone's **name**.
ex: 我以公司的名义邀请您。
I invite you on behalf of the company.
他只是名义上的老板。
He is only the boss in name.
use: Fixed patterns: 以…的名义 (in the name of), 名义上 (nominally).

ex: 老师一一回答了学生的问题。
The teacher answered the students' questions one by one.
请把名字一一写在表上。
Please write the names on the form one by one.
use: Written style; comes before the verb.

m: The **numbers** that **take part** in a formula or machine: **parameters**.
ex: 这台电脑的参数很高。
This computer has high specs.
请先设置好这些参数。
Please set these parameters first.
use: Used for technical specs of phones, computers, cameras.

m: The **commander-in-chief** who **gathers** all troops: **to command**, the **supreme commander**.
ex: 他是这支军队的最高统帅。
He is the supreme commander of this army.
国王亲自统帅大军出征。
The king personally led the great army to war.
use: Formal, military or historical.

ex: 区长今天来学校看了看。
The district head visited the school today.
他当了五年区长。
He was district chief for five years.
use: Head of a city district (区); compare 市长 mayor, 县长 county head.

m: The **squares** on a board and how the **office** is laid out: a **pattern** or **structure**.
ex: 这套房子的格局很好。
This flat has a good layout.
世界经济的格局正在变化。
The pattern of the world economy is changing.
use: Used for room layouts and for big-picture setups; 有格局 also means broad-minded.

m: **One** **hand** that can do it well: **a skill**, **mastery**.
ex: 他做菜很有一手。
He's really good at cooking.
这是我一手带大的孩子。
This is a child I raised single-handedly.
use: 有一手 means be skilled at; 一手 before a verb means all by oneself.

m: Someone who **teaches** and makes you **practise**: a **coach**.
ex: 我们的游泳教练很严格。
Our swimming coach is very strict.
他在学校教练篮球队。
He coaches the basketball team at school.
use: Mostly a noun: 教练 for sports and driving (驾校教练).

ex: 西安是一座有名的古城。
Xi'an is a famous ancient city.
我们在古城里走了一下午。
We walked around the old town all afternoon.
use: Measure word 座.

m: It **closes** neatly into the **square** marked for it: **qualified**, up to standard.
ex: 这些产品都合格了。
These products have all passed inspection.
他是一个合格的老师。
He is a qualified, capable teacher.
use: Opposite 不合格; 及格 is passing a test score.

ex: 周末我喜欢在家看电视娱乐一下。
At weekends I like to relax at home watching TV.
这个城市的娱乐活动很多。
There's a lot of entertainment in this city.
use: Common as a noun: 娱乐节目, 娱乐圈 (showbiz).

ex: 请用力推门。
Please push the door hard.
他用力地握了握我的手。
He shook my hand firmly.
use: Physical effort; 努力 is effort in work or study.

m: **Ten thousand** **experiences**, a hopeful reign name: **Wanli**, a Ming emperor.
ex: 万历皇帝在位四十多年。
The Wanli Emperor reigned for over forty years.
这个瓷碗是万历年间的。
This porcelain bowl is from the Wanli period.
use: A reign title (1573–1620); used with 年间 or 皇帝.

m: The **scenery** **in front** of you: the **outlook** or **prospects**.
ex: 这个行业的前景很好。
This industry has good prospects.
我对未来的前景很乐观。
I'm optimistic about the outlook for the future.
use: Usually means prospects; also foreground in a picture.

ex: 古代的皇帝被称为天子。
Emperors in ancient times were called the Son of Heaven.
天子住在京城里。
The emperor lived in the capital.
use: Historical and literary; 子 here means son, not a noun suffix.

m: **Earth** **home** **people**: the name of the **Tujia ethnic group**.
ex: 土家族主要住在湖南和湖北。
The Tujia live mainly in Hunan and Hubei.
她是土家族人。
She is Tujia.
use: One of China's 56 recognized ethnic groups; 族 marks an ethnic group.

m: **Depend on** and **depend on** again: to **rely on** heavily.
ex: 孩子不能总是依赖父母。
Children can't always depend on their parents.
我对手机的依赖越来越大。
I'm getting more and more dependent on my phone.
use: Often negative, over-reliance; 依靠 is neutral reliance.

m: **Few** trees in the **woods** on Mount Song: **Shaolin**, the famous monastery.
ex: 他去少林寺学过功夫。
He went to the Shaolin Temple to learn kung fu.
少林功夫在全世界都很有名。
Shaolin kung fu is famous all over the world.
use: Usually 少林寺 (the temple) or 少林功夫.

ex: 那几年的生活很艰难。
Life was very hard in those years.
他艰难地站了起来。
He struggled to his feet.
use: Stronger and more written than 难 or 困难.

ex: 他上前跟老人打招呼。
He stepped forward to greet the old man.
警察上前问了几个问题。
The police officer went up and asked a few questions.
use: Often followed by another verb: 上前问, 上前帮忙.

ex: 海底有很多美丽的鱼。
There are many beautiful fish at the bottom of the sea.
这条隧道是从海底通过的。
This tunnel runs under the seabed.
use: Also in 海底捞, a well-known hotpot chain.

m: An **area** and **field** where government **walks** its **political** work: an **administrative area**.
ex: 中国有很多不同的行政区域。
China has many different administrative areas.
这个镇属于哪个行政区域？
Which administrative area does this town belong to?
use: Formal; often shortened to 行政区.

ex: 沙漠变为了绿洲。
The desert turned into an oasis.
冰在太阳下慢慢变为水。
Ice slowly turns into water in the sun.
use: Written style of 变成; 为 is read wéi here.

ex: 桌上摆满了美味佳肴。
The table was covered with delicious dishes.
这道菜是当地的一道佳肴。
This dish is a local delicacy.
use: Literary; usually 美味佳肴.

ex: 学校动员学生参加植树活动。
The school mobilized students to plant trees.
社区开了一次动员大会。
The community held a rally to get people involved.
use: Pattern: 动员 + someone + to do something.

m: The **big** **earth** under the sky: **the earth**, the land.
ex: 春天来了，大地变绿了。
Spring has come and the land has turned green.
太阳照在大地上。
The sun shines on the earth.
use: Poetic and descriptive; 地球 is the planet Earth.

m: **Dispatch** a member of the **clique**: **send someone on a mission**.
ex: 公司派遣他去上海工作。
The company sent him to work in Shanghai.
政府派遣了医疗队去灾区。
The government dispatched a medical team to the disaster area.
use: Formal; in speech 派 alone is common.

ex: 直至深夜，会议才结束。
The meeting didn't end until late at night.
他每天学习，直至考试结束。
He studied every day right up until the exam was over.
use: Written style of 直到; often 直至今日, to this day.

m: The **big** **body** of it, not the details: **in general**, **roughly**.
ex: 你的想法大体上是对的。
Your idea is right on the whole.
我大体知道怎么走了。
I roughly know how to get there now.
use: Often 大体上; similar to 基本上.

m: Something **fit** just **now** happened: **just now**, a moment ago.
ex: 适才有人来找你。
Someone came looking for you just now.
适才的话请您别放在心上。
Please don't take what I said a moment ago to heart.
use: Old-fashioned and literary; everyday speech uses 刚才.

m: Set a **period of time** **in advance** in your mind: to **expect**, an **expectation**.
ex: 比赛结果跟我们预期的一样。
The result of the match was as we expected.
这次考试没有达到预期。
This exam fell short of expectations.
use: Common in 达到预期, 超出预期 (beyond expectations).

m: The group a **party** **entrusts** with power: a **Party committee**.
ex: 这件事要先报告党委。
This has to be reported to the Party committee first.
他是学校党委书记。
He is the Party secretary of the school.
use: Short for 党的委员会; 党委书记 is the Party secretary.

ex: 在大城市买房很不易。
Buying a flat in a big city is not easy.
这个机会来之不易。
This opportunity didn't come easily.
use: More written than 不容易; fixed phrase 来之不易, hard-won.

ex: 大队人马已经出发了。
The main body of people has already set off.
他是交警大队的队长。
He is the head of the traffic police brigade.
use: Used for police, army or old rural units; 大队人马, a large crowd.

m: The **cup** for the whole **world** across every **boundary**: the **World Cup**.
ex: 我每四年都看世界杯。
I watch the World Cup every four years.
今年的世界杯在哪儿举行？
Where is this year's World Cup being held?
use: Usually means the football World Cup.

m: **Beckon** someone and **call** out: to **greet** them or call to them.
ex: 他看见我就跟我打招呼。
He said hello as soon as he saw me.
有人在门口招呼你。
Someone is calling you at the door.
use: Very common as 打招呼, say hello; also 招呼客人, look after guests.

ex: 这是一个难得的机会。
This is a rare opportunity.
你难得来一次，多住几天吧。
You so rarely come, stay a few more days.
use: Before a verb it means seldom: 难得见面, rarely meet.

m: A **head** of hair tied in a **forked** bun: a **girl**.
ex: 这个丫头真聪明。
This girl is really clever.
丫头，快来吃饭！
Come and eat, girl!
use: Spoken and affectionate for a young girl or daughter; in old stories, a servant girl.

m: **South** **lake**: **Nanhu**, the name of a lake and of districts.
ex: 我们在南湖边散步。
We took a walk by South Lake.
南湖公园晚上人很多。
Nanhu Park is crowded in the evening.
use: A place name used in several cities, such as Jiaxing and Wuhan.

ex: 我们开了一个小型会议。
We held a small meeting.
这是一家小型公司。
This is a small company.
use: Goes before nouns; opposite 大型, between them 中型.

m: The **river** Yangtze and the **Han** River: **Jianghan**, a region and a district of Wuhan.
ex: 我住在武汉江汉区。
I live in Jianghan District, Wuhan.
江汉平原是重要的粮食产地。
The Jianghan Plain is an important grain-growing area.
use: Here 汉 is the Han River, not man.

ex: 这次不算，我们再来一次。
This one doesn't count, let's go again.
今天不算太冷。
Today isn't really that cold.
use: 不算 + adjective softens it: not exactly, not too.

m: What your **hand** must **continue** filling in: the **procedure**, paperwork.
ex: 办签证的手续很麻烦。
The visa paperwork is a lot of hassle.
你先去前台办一下入住手续。
Go to the front desk and check in first.
use: Goes with 办: 办手续, do the formalities.

ex: 老师的表情很严肃。
The teacher looked very serious.
这是一个严肃的问题。
This is a serious matter.
use: About manner or atmosphere; 严重 is serious as in bad.

ex: 手机可以给你定位。
Your phone can pinpoint your location.
这个产品的定位是年轻人。
This product is aimed at young people.
use: Means GPS location, and also positioning a product or role.

ex: 这个故事流传了几百年。
This story has been handed down for hundreds of years.
网上流传着很多假消息。
Lots of fake news is circulating online.
use: For stories, songs and sayings spreading over time or space.

m: The age we **are** in, **replacing** the last: the **present age**, contemporary.
ex: 她很喜欢当代艺术。
She loves contemporary art.
这是一本写当代中国的书。
This is a book about China today.
use: Goes before nouns: 当代文学, 当代社会.

ex: 我们打算去东南亚旅游。
We plan to go travelling in Southeast Asia.
东南亚的水果又多又便宜。
Fruit in Southeast Asia is plentiful and cheap.
use: 亚 is short for 亚洲, Asia.

ex: 我们换个话题，转换一下心情。
Let's change the subject and lift the mood.
这个软件可以转换文件格式。
This app can convert file formats.
use: For formats, roles, ways of thinking; 换 alone is more everyday.

m: **Lift** a subject and let it **rise**: **mention**, bring up.
ex: 他从来没提起过他的家人。
He has never mentioned his family.
一提起考试，我就紧张。
As soon as exams are mentioned, I get nervous.
use: Pattern 一提起…就…, whenever… comes up.

ex: 清政府签了很多不平等条约。
The Qing government signed many unequal treaties.
一九一二年清政府结束了。
The Qing government came to an end in 1912.
use: Historical; 清 here is the Qing dynasty, not clear.

m: The **general** one who **takes charge** and gives **orders**: the **commander-in-chief**.
ex: 他是这支部队的总司令。
He is the commander-in-chief of this force.
总司令下令马上出发。
The commander-in-chief ordered them to set off at once.
use: Military title; 司令 alone is a commander.

ex: 这种行为是非法的。
This kind of behaviour is illegal.
他因为非法停车被罚了钱。
He was fined for illegal parking.
use: Opposite 合法; often before nouns: 非法收入.

ex: 这样做对他不公平。
Doing this isn't fair to him.
比赛要公平进行。
The match must be played fairly.
use: Often 对…不公平, unfair to someone.

ex: 这条河里有很多淡水鱼。
There are lots of freshwater fish in this river.
我更喜欢吃淡水鱼。
I prefer eating freshwater fish.
use: Measure word 条; 淡水 means fresh water, 海水鱼 is saltwater fish.

m: **Perilla** herb **prefecture**: the name of **Suzhou**, the garden city.
ex: 苏州的园林非常有名。
Suzhou's gardens are very famous.
我下个月要去苏州出差。
I'm going to Suzhou on business next month.
use: City near Shanghai, known for gardens and canals.

ex: 敌人在夜里袭击了村子。
The enemy attacked the village at night.
台风袭击了沿海城市。
The typhoon hit the coastal cities.
use: Also for storms and diseases striking.

ex: 我看出他不太高兴。
I could tell he wasn't very happy.
你从哪里看出来他在说谎？
How could you tell he was lying?
use: Often 看出来; splits as 看得出 or 看不出, can or can't tell.

ex: 他一下就把蚊子打死了。
He killed the mosquito with one slap.
打死我也不去！
I won't go even if you kill me!
use: 打死也不 is a spoken way to say absolutely not.

ex: 这个数目不对。
This number isn't right.
这可不是一个小数目。
This is no small sum.
use: Often about money: 小数目, 大数目.

ex: 今年粮食总产量增加了。
Total grain output rose this year.
这家工厂的年总产量很高。
This factory's annual total output is very high.
use: Economics and farming word; 产量 alone is output.

m: A **wish** made under the **full moon**: a **wish**, desire.
ex: 我的愿望是去世界各地旅行。
My wish is to travel around the world.
希望你的愿望能实现。
I hope your wish comes true.
use: Goes with 实现 (come true) and 许 (make a wish).

m: A **scholar** of the **courtyard** of learning: a **member of a national academy**.
ex: 他是中国科学院的院士。
He is a member of the Chinese Academy of Sciences.
这位院士做了一个讲座。
The academician gave a lecture.
use: Top scientific honour in China; title used with the surname, 王院士.

ex: 这座桥是用花岗岩建的。
This bridge is built of granite.
花岗岩非常坚硬。
Granite is very hard.
use: Measure word 块 for a piece.

ex: 他是个小人，别相信他。
He's a petty, two-faced person, don't trust him.
我们不要做背后说人坏话的小人。
Let's not be the kind of mean people who badmouth others behind their backs.
use: Usually means a mean or scheming person; opposite 君子.

ex: 他们父子俩长得很像。
The father and son look very alike.
这对父子一起开了一家店。
This father and son opened a shop together.
use: Often 父子俩, the two of them; 母女 is mother and daughter.

ex: 他跪下来向她求婚。
He knelt down and proposed to her.
孩子们跪下给爷爷磕头。
The children knelt and kowtowed to their grandfather.
use: Often 跪下来; a strong sign of respect or pleading.

m: **Yellow**, **school**, and the old name **Xi**: **Huang Zongxi**, a Ming-Qing thinker.
ex: 黄宗羲是明末清初的思想家。
Huang Zongxi was a thinker of the late Ming and early Qing.
我们在课上读了黄宗羲的文章。
We read an essay by Huang Zongxi in class.
use: A personal name: surname 黄.

ex: 城墙上放着几门火炮。
Several cannons stand on the city wall.
古代火炮比现在的简单。
Ancient cannons were simpler than today's.
use: Measure word 门; military word.

ex: 马路两边都是树。
There are trees on both sides of the road.
他两边都不想得罪。
He doesn't want to offend either side.
use: Can mean two places or two parties in a dispute.

ex: 我妹妹今年十四岁。
My little sister is fourteen this year.
我们班有十四个男生。
There are fourteen boys in our class.
use: Careful with tones: 十四 shísì and 四十 sìshí (forty) sound alike.

ex: 鸡每天产卵吗？
Do hens lay eggs every day?
这种鱼到河里去产卵。
This kind of fish swims up rivers to spawn.
use: For animals in science and nature texts; hens 下蛋 in speech.

m: A **friend** on the **net**: an **online friend**, internet user.
ex: 很多网友在网上留言。
Many netizens left comments online.
我昨天见了一个网友。
Yesterday I met a friend I'd made online.
use: Also used for internet users in general in news.

ex: 钱固然重要，但不是一切。
Money is admittedly important, but it isn't everything.
这个办法固然好，可是太贵了。
This method is good, of course, but it's too expensive.
use: Concedes a point, followed by 但是 or 可是.

ex: 我们用气球装饰了房间。
We decorated the room with balloons.
这家店的装饰很漂亮。
This shop's decor is lovely.
use: 装修 is renovating a home; 装饰 is the decorative touches.

ex: 西汉的首都是长安。
The capital of the Western Han was Chang'an.
这件文物来自西汉时期。
This relic dates from the Western Han period.
use: Followed by 东汉, Eastern Han.

ex: 他个子中等，不高也不矮。
He's of medium height, neither tall nor short.
她的成绩在班里属于中等。
Her grades are average for her class.
use: Goes before nouns: 中等城市, 中等收入.

ex: 他很少跟外界联系。
He rarely has contact with the outside world.
不要太在意外界的看法。
Don't care too much about what others think.
use: Often 外界的看法 or 外界的影响.

ex: 台湾海峡把大陆和台湾分开。
The Taiwan Strait separates the mainland and Taiwan.
这条海峡很窄，可以看到对岸。
This strait is so narrow you can see the other shore.
use: Also in 海峡两岸, both sides of the Taiwan Strait.

ex: 这个地方汉人和少数民族一起生活。
Han Chinese and ethnic minorities live together here.
古时候北方有很多汉人。
In ancient times there were many Han people in the north.
use: Often in history; today 汉族 is the usual term.

ex: 巴西的足球非常厉害。
Brazil is really strong at football.
我朋友是从巴西来的。
My friend is from Brazil.
use: Country name chosen for sound; 巴西人 is a Brazilian.

ex: 她在班上很活跃。
She is very active in class.
他讲了个笑话，活跃了一下气氛。
He told a joke to liven up the atmosphere.
use: 活跃气氛 is a set phrase: liven things up.

m: The **thing** that is **born** from something: a **product** or **result**.
ex: 这是时代的产物。
This is a product of its time.
城市是经济发展的产物。
Cities are the result of economic development.
use: Abstract: a result of history or circumstances; goods are 产品.

ex: 你的思路很清楚。
Your line of thought is very clear.
电话一响，我的思路就断了。
When the phone rang, my train of thought broke.
use: Goes with 清楚, 打开 (open up), 断 (break).

ex: 我去打听一下他的消息。
I'll go and ask around about him.
你知道去火车站怎么走吗？我想打听一下。
Do you know how to get to the station? I'd like to ask.
use: Asking around for information; neutral, spoken.

ex: 工人们正在搅拌水泥。
The workers are mixing cement.
这条路是水泥路。
This road is concrete.
use: Measure word 袋 (bag); 水泥地, a concrete floor.

m: **Hand over** and **go** back and forth: **associate with**, have contact.
ex: 我不太喜欢跟他交往。
I don't much like spending time with him.
他们交往了两年就结婚了。
They dated for two years and then got married.
use: Can mean friendship or dating; 跟…交往.

m: A **ring** and a **joint** in a chain: a **link** or **stage** in a process.
ex: 这是整个计划中最重要的环节。
This is the most important stage of the whole plan.
每个环节都不能出错。
No step can go wrong.
use: Mostly a link or step in a process; the zoology sense is rare.

ex: 我弟弟比我小三岁。
My younger brother is three years younger than me.
你有弟弟吗？
Do you have a younger brother?
use: Older brother is 哥哥; measure word 个.

m: The **chief** of the **association**: a **president** of a club or society.
ex: 他是我们学校书法协会的会长。
He is president of our school's calligraphy club.
会长明天要开会。
The president is holding a meeting tomorrow.
use: 会 here means association, not can.

ex: 墙上挂着一幅画像。
A portrait hangs on the wall.
画家正在给她画像。
The artist is painting her portrait.
use: Measure word 幅 or 张.

ex: 王爷住在一座大院子里。
The prince lived in a large compound.
电视剧里的王爷都很有钱。
The princes in TV dramas are all very rich.
use: Historical, mostly Qing-dynasty dramas.

ex: 八国联军在一九零零年进入北京。
The Eight-Nation Alliance entered Beijing in 1900.
圆明园被八国联军破坏了。
The Old Summer Palace was damaged by the Eight-Nation Alliance.
use: Historical term from Chinese history lessons.

m: **Hold** and **have**: to **hold** a passport, shares, a view.
ex: 他持有中国护照。
He holds a Chinese passport.
我持有不同的看法。
I hold a different view.
use: Formal; used for documents, shares and opinions.

ex: 小偷当天就被捕了。
The thief was arrested that same day.
他因为偷车被捕。
He was arrested for stealing a car.
use: Here 被 marks the passive, not quilt.

ex: 我们沿着海岸开车。
We drove along the coast.
这里的海岸线很长。
The coastline here is very long.
use: 海岸线 is coastline; 海边 is the everyday seaside.

ex: 我学中文学了半年了。
I've been learning Chinese for half a year.
他半年没回家了。
He hasn't been home for six months.
use: No measure word needed: 半年, not 半个年.

m: **Speak** and let a topic **rise**: **mention**, bring up.
ex: 说起这件事，我就生气。
Whenever this comes up, I get angry.
他跟我说起过你。
He has mentioned you to me.
use: Like 提起; 说起来 also means come to think of it.

ex: 谁也阻止不了他。
No one can stop him.
警察阻止了一场打架。
The police stopped a fight.
use: Stops an action from happening; 防止 prevents something bad in advance.

ex: 代表团一行十人到了北京。
The ten-member delegation arrived in Beijing.
我们一行人坐车去了海边。
Our group went to the seaside by car.
use: Read yìxíng here; yìháng is one line of text.

ex: 他在大学学的是力学。
He studied mechanics at university.
这个问题要用力学知识来解释。
This problem needs knowledge of mechanics to explain.
use: Physics subject; 学 here means a field of study.

ex: 他多半不会来了。
He probably isn't coming.
来参加的多半是学生。
Most of the people who came were students.
use: Spoken; before a verb it means most likely.

m: The **apex** of your **head**: the **top of the head**, overhead.
ex: 一只鸟从我头顶飞过。
A bird flew over my head.
他头顶上的头发少了。
He's losing hair on top of his head.
use: Also overhead: 头顶上.

ex: 十年过去了，他仍旧住在那里。
Ten years have passed and he still lives there.
我说了好几次，他仍旧不听。
I've told him several times, but he still won't listen.
use: Written style of 还是; like 仍然.

ex: 这个工程历时三年。
This project took three years.
比赛历时两个小时才结束。
The match lasted two hours before it ended.
use: Formal, followed by a length of time.

ex: 这片海上有很多岛屿。
There are many islands in this sea.
这个国家由几千个岛屿组成。
This country is made up of thousands of islands.
use: Collective and written; one island is 岛 or 小岛.

ex: 山西出产很多煤炭。
Shanxi produces a lot of coal.
以前冬天家家都烧煤炭取暖。
In the past every home burned coal in winter for heat.
use: General word for coal as a resource; 煤 alone in speech.

ex: 我们当天去当天回。
We'll go and come back the same day.
你买的票只能当天用。
The ticket you bought is only valid for that day.
use: Read dàngtiān in many areas; compare 那天, that day.

ex: 这件工艺品做得很精细。
This craft piece is very finely made.
他做事非常精细。
He does things very meticulously.
use: For craftsmanship and careful work; 仔细 is careful.

ex: 南阳在河南省。
Nanyang is in Henan Province.
诸葛亮年轻时住在南阳。
Zhuge Liang lived in Nanyang when he was young.
use: City name; 阳 here means sunny side.

m: **Drape** off the cover and let it lie like **dew** in the open: **reveal**, disclose.
ex: 报纸披露了这件事的真相。
The newspaper revealed the truth about the affair.
公司还没有披露具体数字。
The company hasn't disclosed the exact figures yet.
use: Formal, used in news and business.

ex: 我猜不到她的心思。
I can't guess what she's thinking.
他没有心思工作。
He's in no mood to work.
use: 没心思 means not in the mood; 花心思 means put thought into.

ex: 这首歌表达了很深的情感。
This song expresses deep emotion.
他不太会表达自己的情感。
He isn't good at expressing his feelings.
use: More formal than 感情; often about emotional life in general.

ex: 我们一起庆祝你的生日吧。
Let's celebrate your birthday together.
全家人出去吃饭庆祝。
The whole family went out to eat to celebrate.
use: Takes an event as object: 庆祝新年.

ex: 我们队击败了对手。
Our team beat its rivals.
他在决赛中击败了世界冠军。
He defeated the world champion in the final.
use: Sports and battles; 打败 is more spoken.

m: Someone you share **meals** with and **partner**: a **companion**, partner.
ex: 他是我小时候的伙伴。
He was my childhood companion.
这两家公司是合作伙伴。
These two companies are business partners.
use: 合作伙伴 is a business partner.

ex: 今年房价大幅上涨。
House prices rose sharply this year.
街上挂着一幅大幅广告。
A large banner advert hangs over the street.
use: Mostly before verbs of change: 大幅增加, 大幅下降.

ex: 我在大学学汉语。
I study Chinese at university.
你的汉语说得真好！
Your Chinese is really good!
use: Same as 中文 in most uses; 汉语 is more about spoken language.

m: Give a **certificate** that it is **real**: **confirm**, verify.
ex: 警方已经证实了这个消息。
The police have confirmed the news.
我的猜测被证实了。
My guess was proved right.
use: Confirm something is true; 证明 is prove.

m: The **same** **period of time**: the **same period** last year, or concurrent.
ex: 今年的收入比去年同期高。
This year's income is higher than the same period last year.
他们是同期毕业的同学。
They were classmates who graduated at the same time.
use: Common in reports: 与去年同期相比.

ex: 这条路是单行道。
This road is one-way.
真是祸不单行，我又丢了钥匙。
Misfortunes never come singly: I've lost my keys too.
use: Mostly in 单行道 and the saying 祸不单行.

ex: 这个箱子的重量是多少？
What does this box weigh?
行李超过了重量限制。
The luggage is over the weight limit.
use: Body weight is usually 体重.

m: How you are **waited** on when they **encounter** you: **treatment**, pay and benefits.
ex: 这家公司的待遇很好。
This company pays well.
我们在那里受到了很好的待遇。
We were treated very well there.
use: Often pay and perks at work: 工资待遇.

m: Your **growing** life up to its **border**: a **career**.
ex: 他的足球生涯很成功。
His football career was very successful.
她开始了教师生涯。
She began her career as a teacher.
use: Formal; pairs with a field: 演艺生涯, 职业生涯.

ex: 鄂州离武汉很近。
Ezhou is close to Wuhan.
他是湖北鄂州人。
He's from Ezhou in Hubei.
use: 鄂 is the short name for Hubei.

ex: 我不怕冷，冬天也穿得很少。
I don't mind the cold; I wear little even in winter.
不怕慢，就怕停。
Don't fear going slowly, only fear standing still.
use: Pattern 不怕…就怕…, it isn't A that matters but B.

m: From this **using** point to the **south**: **south of**.
ex: 长江以南的冬天比较湿冷。
Winters south of the Yangtze are damp and cold.
这个城市在北京以南。
This city is south of Beijing.
use: Comes after a place: 长江以南; also 以北, 以东, 以西.

m: An **example** made into a thing: an **example**, instance.
ex: 你能举个例子吗？
Can you give an example?
这就是一个很好的例子。
This is a very good example.
use: Goes with 举: 举例子, give an example.

ex: 房子被警察包围了。
The house was surrounded by police.
我们被一群孩子包围了。
We were surrounded by a crowd of children.
use: Often passive: 被…包围.

ex: 咸宁在湖北省南部。
Xianning is in southern Hubei.
咸宁的温泉很有名。
Xianning's hot springs are famous.
use: City name; 咸 here is the old sense all, not salty.

ex: 我报名参加了比赛。
I signed up for the competition.
你报名了吗？明天就截止了。
Have you signed up? It closes tomorrow.
use: Pattern 报名参加 + event; separable: 报了名.

ex: 这个房间很温暖。
This room is very warm.
你的话温暖了我的心。
Your words warmed my heart.
use: Often for feelings; 暖和 is more for weather and rooms in speech.

m: The **raw** element that **arouses** the body: a **hormone**.
ex: 这种药里有激素。
This medicine contains hormones.
激素会影响人的情绪。
Hormones can affect people's moods.
use: Medical and science word.

ex: 美国是一个联邦国家。
The United States is a federal country.
他在联邦政府工作。
He works for the federal government.
use: Used for the US, Germany and similar states.

ex: 新赛季下个月开始。
The new season starts next month.
他这个赛季进了二十个球。
He scored twenty goals this season.
use: Sports only; a weather season is 季节.

ex: 婴儿在床上睡着了。
The baby fell asleep on the bed.
这家商店卖婴儿用品。
This shop sells baby products.
use: More formal than 宝宝; 婴儿车 is a pram.

ex: 他是我们公司的劳动模范。
He is a model worker at our company.
她是一位模范妈妈。
She is a model mother.
use: Often in praise: 模范作用, 劳动模范.

ex: 他在一家房地产公司工作。
He works at a real estate company.
这几年房地产市场变化很大。
The property market has changed a lot in recent years.
use: Abbreviated 地产 in company names.

ex: 他喜欢收集邮票。
He likes collecting stamps.
我们正在收集大家的意见。
We are gathering everyone's opinions.
use: For hobbies and information; 收藏 is collecting valuables.

ex: 这张照片很清晰。
This photo is very sharp.
他说话很清晰。
He speaks very clearly.
use: For images, sounds and thinking; 清楚 is more everyday.

m: A **system** of **agreements** that holds you back: to **restrict**, constrain.
ex: 经济发展受到很多因素的制约。
Economic development is held back by many factors.
交通问题制约了城市的发展。
Traffic problems are limiting the city's growth.
use: Formal; often 受到…制约.

ex: 他受命去调查这件事。
He was ordered to investigate the matter.
她受命担任新的校长。
She was appointed as the new head teacher.
use: Formal and written.

ex: 你应该事先告诉我。
You should have told me in advance.
我们事先没有准备。
We hadn't prepared beforehand.
use: Opposite 事后, afterwards; similar to 提前.

ex: 婚礼的场面非常热闹。
The wedding was a lively scene.
这部电影的打斗场面很精彩。
The fight scenes in this film are great.
use: Also means appearances: 讲场面, keep up appearances.

ex: 香港曾经是英国的殖民地。
Hong Kong was once a British colony.
很多国家以前都是殖民地。
Many countries used to be colonies.
use: History word; 殖民 means colonize.

ex: 汽车客运站在城东。
The coach station is on the east side of town.
春节期间客运量很大。
Passenger traffic is very heavy during Spring Festival.
use: Opposite 货运, freight; 客运站 is a bus or coach station.

ex: 山上的风景非常壮丽。
The scenery in the mountains is magnificent.
我们看到了壮丽的日出。
We saw a magnificent sunrise.
use: For landscapes and grand sights.

m: The **compass** and the **carpenter's square**: **rules**, proper behaviour.
ex: 这是我们家的规矩。
That's the rule in our house.
这孩子很规矩。
This child is very well-behaved.
use: Often unwritten rules: 守规矩, 没规矩 (bad manners).

ex: 老人早就准备好了棺材。
The old man had long since prepared his coffin.
他们把棺材抬上了山。
They carried the coffin up the hill.
use: Measure word 口 or 具; a sensitive topic.

ex: 两国的关系很紧密。
The two countries have close ties.
我们要紧密合作。
We need to work closely together.
use: For ties and cooperation; 亲密 is close in feelings.

ex: 他半点也不担心。
He isn't the least bit worried.
这件事跟我没有半点关系。
This has nothing whatsoever to do with me.
use: Used with negatives: 半点也不, 没有半点.

ex: 他爷爷去年去世了。
His grandfather passed away last year.
听说那位作家去世了。
I heard that writer has died.
use: Polite way to say 死; takes no object.

ex: 这批产品要检验以后才能卖。
This batch must be inspected before it can be sold.
实践是检验真理的标准。
Practice is the test of truth.
use: For products and quality; 检查 is a general check-up.

ex: 海水是咸的。
Seawater is salty.
今天的海水很凉。
The sea is cold today.
use: 海水 vs 淡水, fresh water.

ex: 这台电脑的配置很好。
This computer has a good spec.
公司重新配置了人员。
The company reassigned its staff.
use: Very common for computer and phone specs.

ex: 那个小孩在哭。
That child is crying.
我家有两个小孩。
I have two kids.
use: Spoken; also 小孩子, 孩子.

ex: 这种药可以杀死细菌。
This medicine can kill bacteria.
猎人杀死了一只狼。
The hunter killed a wolf.
use: Result verb: the killing succeeds; 杀 alone may not.

m: **Report** your name for a **test**: **apply to sit an exam**.
ex: 他报考了北京大学。
He applied to sit the exam for Peking University.
今年报考公务员的人很多。
Many people signed up for the civil service exam this year.
use: Object is a school or an exam.

ex: 瑞士的手表很有名。
Swiss watches are famous.
我们夏天去瑞士滑雪了。
We went skiing in Switzerland in the summer.
use: Don't mix up 瑞士 Switzerland and 瑞典 Sweden.

ex: 这是现行的法律。
This is the law currently in force.
现行的规定不太合理。
The current rules aren't very reasonable.
use: Formal; before nouns like 法律, 制度, 政策.

ex: 这是一个庞大的工程。
This is a huge project.
公司的组织非常庞大。
The company's organization is enormous.
use: Often for organizations, numbers, buildings; can sound unwieldy.

ex: 老人很有智慧。
The old man is very wise.
这本书里有很多生活的智慧。
This book holds a lot of wisdom about life.
use: Also used for smart tech: 智慧城市.

ex: 这个城市的人口数超过一千万。
This city's population is over ten million.
今年全国的人口数有所下降。
The national population has fallen somewhat this year.
use: Formal; 人口 alone is the usual word.

ex: 他没有好好复习，以致考试没及格。
He didn't revise properly, so he failed the exam.
雨下得很大，以致很多航班取消了。
It rained so hard that many flights were cancelled.
use: Usually a bad result; written style.

ex: 这里冬季很少下雪。
It rarely snows here in winter.
冬季运动会明年举行。
The Winter Games will be held next year.
use: More formal than 冬天.

ex: 她考上了北大。
She got into Peking University.
北大的校园很漂亮。
Peking University's campus is beautiful.
use: Short for 北京大学.

ex: 远处有一座山。
There's a mountain in the distance.
他站在远处看着我们。
He stood in the distance watching us.
use: Often 从远处 or 在远处.

ex: 这支部队的建制很完整。
This unit's organizational structure is complete.
这个县的建制已经有几百年了。
This county has existed as an administrative unit for hundreds of years.
use: Formal; army or administrative units.

ex: 考古学家发掘了一座古墓。
Archaeologists excavated an ancient tomb.
我们要发掘每个学生的潜力。
We need to bring out every student's potential.
use: Also used for talent: 发掘人才.

ex: 他是这个项目最大的贡献者。
He is the biggest contributor to this project.
网站感谢所有的贡献者。
The website thanks all its contributors.
use: 者 makes 贡献 into a person.

ex: 这条河的下游很宽。
The river is very wide in its lower reaches.
上海在长江下游。
Shanghai is on the lower reaches of the Yangtze.
use: Opposite 上游, upper reaches; also used for supply chains.

ex: 他们一家人生活得很和谐。
Their family lives in harmony.
我们要建设和谐社会。
We should build a harmonious society.
use: Common in official slogans; also for colours and music.

ex: 王公贵族住在城里最好的地方。
Princes and nobles lived in the best part of the city.
古代的王公生活很奢侈。
Ancient nobles lived in luxury.
use: Historical; often 王公贵族.

ex: 听了他的笑话，大家哈哈大笑。
Everyone roared with laughter at his joke.
他看着照片哈哈大笑起来。
He looked at the photo and burst out laughing.
use: Often followed by 起来.

ex: 苏东坡曾经住在黄州。
Su Dongpo once lived in Huangzhou.
黄州是一个历史悠久的地方。
Huangzhou is a place with a long history.
use: Place name in Huanggang, Hubei.

ex: 他匆匆吃了几口饭就走了。
He gulped down a few mouthfuls and left.
时间过得匆匆。
Time passes in a rush.
use: Often 匆匆忙忙; describes hurried actions.

ex: 我收回刚才的话。
I take back what I just said.
银行收回了贷款。
The bank recalled the loan.
use: For words, money, land or decisions.
